enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed in Bedroom 1. Pull the blanket over the body. Close eyes. Turn onto the right side. Adjust the pillow under the head. Turn onto the left side. Push the blanket down to the waist. Pull the blanket back up. Turn over onto the back. Stretch both arms above the head. Lower the arms. Turn onto the right side again. Remain lying still with eyes closed. Turn over once more. Lie on the back with arms at the sides.

enriched_activities.activity: Wake up, wash face, brush teeth, use toilet
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up on the bed. Swing both legs off the bed. Stand up. Walk from Bedroom 1 to the Bathroom. Open the Bathroom door. Turn on the Bathroom light. Use the toilet. Stand up. Press the flush button. Walk to the sink. Turn on the tap. Cup both hands under the water. Rinse the face. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face. Hang the towel back. Pick up the toothbrush. Turn on the tap. Wet the toothbrush. Turn off the tap. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush teeth. Turn on the tap. Rinse the mouth. Spit into the sink. Turn off the tap. Put the toothbrush back. Turn off the Bathroom light. Open the door. Walk out of the Bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Prepare and eat breakfast, check phone for news about the transport strike
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the Kitchen. Open the Refrigerator door. Take out milk and eggs. Close the Refrigerator door. Put the items on the counter. Pick up the bread. Place two slices into the Toaster. Press the lever down on the Toaster. Pick up the egg. Crack the egg into a pan. Turn on the InductionCooker. Pour oil into the pan. Fry the egg. Turn off the InductionCooker. Slide the egg onto a plate. Take the toast out of the Toaster. Put the toast on the plate. Pick up the plate. Sit down at the table. Pick up the Phone. Unlock the Phone. Open the news app. Scroll through articles about the transport strike. Put the Phone down on the table. Pick up the fork. Cut the egg. Lift the fork to the mouth. Eat the toast. Drink the milk. Stand up. Carry the plate and cup to the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the plate and cup. Turn off the tap.

enriched_activities.activity: Stretch and do light bodyweight exercise while listening to news
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the Kitchen to the Living Room. Pick up the TV remote. Press the power button. Turn on the TV. Switch the channel to the news. Put the remote down. Stand in the middle of the room. Raise both arms overhead. Lower the arms. Bend forward and reach toward the floor. Stand up. Rotate the torso to the left. Rotate the torso to the right. Do ten squats. Place both hands on the hips. Do ten side leg raises with the left leg. Repeat with the right leg. Do ten arm circles forward. Do ten arm circles backward. Pick up the remote. Press the power button. Turn off the TV. Put the remote down.

enriched_activities.activity: Set up desk with computer and desk lamp for a remote workday
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the Living Room to Bedroom 1. Close the Bedroom 1 door. Pick up the Computer from the shelf. Place the Computer on the desk. Open the lid of the Computer. Pick up the DeskLamp. Place the DeskLamp on the desk. Press the switch on the DeskLamp. Adjust the lamp head toward the desk. Plug the Computer charger into the wall socket. Connect the charger to the Computer. Pull out the chair. Sit down on the chair. Press the power button on the Computer. Wait for the screen to load. Log in with the password. Open the email application. Turn on the Fan. Adjust the Fan toward the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Remote work: emails, community program planning, phone calls with partner organizations
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at the desk in front of the Computer. Open the email inbox. Read new messages. Type replies on the keyboard. Click the send button. Open the calendar application. Open the program planning document. Type notes into the document. Save the file. Pick up the Phone. Dial the first partner organization. Speak on the phone. Take notes on paper with a pen. End the call. Put the Phone down. Type follow-up notes into the Computer. Pick up the Phone again. Dial the second partner organization. Speak on the phone. End the call. Put the Phone down. Open the spreadsheet. Enter program session data. Save the spreadsheet. Stand up. Walk to the Kitchen. Fill a glass with water from the tap. Drink the water. Walk back to Bedroom 1. Sit down at the desk. Open a new email. Type the message. Attach the planning document. Click send. Continue reading and replying to emails. Adjust the DeskLamp angle.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating lunch with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the desk. Walk from Bedroom 1 to the Kitchen. Greet Member 2. Open the Refrigerator door. Take out vegetables and cheese. Close the Refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables on the cutting board. Turn on the InductionCooker. Pour oil into the pan. Add the vegetables to the pan. Stir with a spatula. Turn off the InductionCooker. Slide the food onto two plates. Carry the plates to the table. Sit down at the table opposite Member 2. Pick up the fork. Eat the meal. Talk with Member 2 about the transport strike news. Drink water. Stand up. Carry the plates to the sink. Place the plates in the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Take a break, watch TV and rest
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the Kitchen to the Living Room. Pick up the TV remote. Press the power button. Turn on the TV. Sit down on the sofa. Change channels with the remote. Put the remote down on the cushion. Lean back on the sofa. Watch the TV screen. Pick up the remote again. Lower the volume. Put the remote down. Close eyes for a short rest. Open eyes. Sit up straight. Lean back again. Pick up the remote. Press the power button. Turn off the TV. Stand up from the sofa.

enriched_activities.activity: Remote work: grant reporting and scheduling program sessions
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the Living Room to Bedroom 1. Pull out the chair. Sit down at the desk. Open the grant reporting document on the Computer. Type figures into the reporting template. Open the budget spreadsheet. Copy numbers from the spreadsheet. Paste the numbers into the reporting document. Save the document. Open the calendar application. Check available dates for program sessions. Type session dates into the calendar. Send calendar invitations by email. Pick up the Phone. Call a venue contact to confirm a session date. End the call. Put the Phone down. Continue entering grant data. Stand up. Stretch both arms. Sit down again. Open a new email. Type an update message to the supervisor. Click send. Save all open files. Adjust the DeskLamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Making tea and taking a short break with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the chair. Walk from Bedroom 1 to the Kitchen. Greet Member 2. Pick up the Kettle. Fill the Kettle with water from the tap. Place the Kettle on its base. Press the switch to boil the water. Open the cupboard. Take out two mugs. Place the mugs on the counter. Drop tea bags into the mugs. Pour the boiled water into the mugs. Pick up a mug. Hand the second mug to Member 2. Sit down at the table with Member 2. Drink the tea. Talk with Member 2 about the evening grocery list. Stand up. Carry the empty mug to the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Remote work: prepare meeting notes and reply to follow-up emails
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the Kitchen to Bedroom 1. Sit down at the desk. Open the meeting notes document on the Computer. Type the agenda points. Add bullet points for program updates. Save the document. Open the email inbox. Read follow-up emails. Type replies. Click send. Open the shared folder. Attach the meeting notes file to an email. Click send. Pick up the Phone. Check messages from partner organizations. Type a reply message. Put the Phone down. Open the calendar. Add the meeting time. Save the calendar entry. Close the email application. Type final notes into the document. Save the file.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short walk around the neighbourhood with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the chair. Walk to the front door. Pick up the keys from the hook. Pick up the jacket. Put on the jacket. Open the front door. Step outside with Member 2. Close the front door. Walk along the pavement with Member 2. Turn right at the corner. Cross the street. Continue walking past the houses. Talk with Member 2 about the day's work. Turn left at the end of the block. Walk back along the opposite pavement. Cross the street again. Walk up to the front door. Open the front door. Step inside with Member 2. Close the front door.

enriched_activities.activity: Walk to local shops to buy groceries for the week
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the reusable shopping bags. Open the front door. Step outside with Member 2. Close the front door. Walk down the street to the local shops. Open the shop door. Step inside. Pick up a shopping basket. Walk through the aisles. Take vegetables from the shelf. Place them in the basket. Take rice and pasta from the shelf. Place them in the basket. Take milk and eggs from the fridge shelf. Place them in the basket. Carry the basket to the till. Place the items on the counter. Pay with the card. Place the items into the reusable bags. Pick up the bags. Walk out of the shop. Walk back to the house with Member 2. Open the front door. Step inside. Close the front door.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the Kitchen with the grocery bags. Place the bags on the counter. Open the Refrigerator door. Put the milk, eggs and vegetables inside. Close the Refrigerator door. Take out the ingredients for dinner. Place them on the counter. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables on the cutting board. Turn on the InductionCooker. Pour oil into the pan. Add the vegetables to the pan. Stir with a spatula. Add salt from the container. Turn off the InductionCooker. Slide the food onto two plates. Carry the plates to the table. Sit down at the table with Member 2. Pick up the fork. Eat the dinner. Talk with Member 2 about the grocery shopping. Drink water from the glass. Stand up. Carry the plates to the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying up with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Stand at the sink. Turn on the tap. Pick up the sponge. Squeeze soap onto the sponge. Pick up a plate. Wipe the plate with the sponge. Rinse the plate under the tap. Place the plate in the drying rack. Pick up the next plate. Wipe and rinse it. Place it in the drying rack. Pick up the glasses. Wipe each glass. Rinse each glass. Place them in the drying rack. Pick up the pan. Scrub the pan with the sponge. Rinse the pan. Place it in the drying rack. Turn off the tap. Pick up the cloth. Wipe the countertop. Wipe the table. Put the cloth back. Pick up the leftovers. Place them in containers. Open the Refrigerator door. Put the containers inside. Close the Refrigerator door. Turn off the Kitchen Light.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the Kitchen to the Living Room. Pick up the TV remote. Press the power button. Turn on the TV. Sit down on the sofa next to Member 2. Change channels with the remote. Select a programme. Put the remote down on the cushion. Lean back on the sofa. Watch the TV screen. Talk with Member 2 about the programme. Pick up the remote. Raise the volume. Put the remote down. Stretch both arms. Lean back again. Watch the screen.

enriched_activities.activity: Shower
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the sofa. Walk from the Living Room to the Bathroom. Open the Bathroom door. Turn on the Bathroom Light. Turn on the WaterHeater. Open the shower curtain. Turn on the shower tap. Adjust the water temperature. Step into the shower. Wet the body under the water. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over the body. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Pour shampoo into the palm. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair under the water. Turn off the shower tap. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel. Dry the body with the towel. Dry the hair with the towel. Hang the towel on the rail. Turn off the WaterHeater. Turn off the Bathroom Light. Open the door. Walk out of the Bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Read, journal and work on a personal project on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the Bathroom to Bedroom 1. Sit down on the bed. Pick up the book from the bedside table. Open the book. Read several pages. Close the book. Put the book back on the bedside table. Pick up the notebook and pen. Open the notebook. Write journal entries. Close the notebook. Put the notebook and pen down. Stand up. Walk to the desk. Pull out the chair. Sit down. Press the power button on the Computer. Open the personal project file. Type text on the keyboard. Adjust the DeskLamp. Click and drag images in the file. Save the file. Open the music player. Play a track. Continue typing. Save the file again. Close the application. Stand up from the chair. Walk to the bed. Sit down on the bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Night routine: brush teeth and wash
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the bed. Walk from Bedroom 1 to the Bathroom. Open the Bathroom door. Turn on the Bathroom Light. Walk to the sink. Turn on the tap. Cup both hands under the water. Rinse the face. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face. Hang the towel back. Pick up the toothbrush. Turn on the tap. Wet the toothbrush. Turn off the tap. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush teeth. Turn on the tap. Rinse the mouth. Spit into the sink. Turn off the tap. Put the toothbrush back in the holder. Turn off the Bathroom Light. Open the door. Walk out of the Bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Make herbal tea and do a light tidy-up
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the Bathroom to the Kitchen. Turn on the Kitchen Light. Pick up the Kettle. Fill the Kettle with water from the tap. Place the Kettle on its base. Press the switch to boil the water. Open the cupboard. Take out a mug. Place the mug on the counter. Drop a herbal tea bag into the mug. Pour the boiled water into the mug. Pick up the mug. Walk to the table. Sit down. Drink the tea. Stand up. Carry the mug to the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the mug. Turn off the tap. Place the mug in the drying rack. Pick up the cloth. Wipe the countertop. Put the cloth back. Straighten the chairs at the table. Turn off the Kitchen Light. Walk out of the Kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the Kitchen to Bedroom 1. Close the Bedroom 1 door. Turn off the DeskLamp. Turn off the Fan. Pull back the blanket. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Adjust the pillow under the head. Close eyes. Turn onto the right side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulders. Turn onto the left side. Lie still. Turn onto the back. Adjust the blanket. Remain lying with eyes closed.
